text: grep -n "fn emit_regular_key_compare_x86_64" -A14 src/codegen_support/runtime/arrays/hash_key_compare.rs:  // reserve key words, scratch slots, and a private decimal buffer 305- emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 8], rdi"); // save the left key low word 306- emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 16], rsi"); // save the left key high word or integer sentinel 307- emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 24], rdx"); // save the right key low word 308- emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 32], rcx"); // save the right key high word or integer sentinel 309- emitter.instruction("cmp rsi, -1"); // does the left key use the integer sentinel? 310- emitter.instruction("je __rt_key_compare_regular_x_left_int"); // route an integer left key to the remaining tag checks 311- emitter.instruction("cmp rcx, -1"); // does the right key use the integer sentinel? 312- emitter.instruction("je __rt_key_compare_regular_x_mixed_right_int"); // normalize a string-left/integer-right mixed comparison
